name: vbd-surveillance-sankhuwasabha
description: Daily dengue and scrub typhus reporting for Health Office Sankhuwasabha — Google Apps Script web app over a Google Sheets database.

scripts.test: npm run build:gas && npm run check:syntax && npm run check:contract && npm run test:backend && npm run test:edge && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:setup && npm run test:transport && npm run test:proxy
